notes: Solved independently first. Facing east and turning right gives south; south then right gives west; west then right gives north, so the fourth leg is north and its length is 20 - (2+4+6) = 8 steps. Net east component 2 - 6 = -4 (4 steps west); net north component 8 - 4 = +4 (4 steps north). Equal westward and northward components give a direction exactly north-west, option 1. Checked with python. Every printed equation follows from the one above it, and the turn sequence used in step 1 is the correct one for right turns. The single common_mistakes entry is true: after only three legs the displacement is 4 west and 4 south, that is south-west, which is not among the four printed choices, so option is correctly left null. Difficulty easy and mistake_type_hint application are both reasonable. Considered but did not file: only one common_mistakes entry is present, which is thin coverage but not itself an error.
